commands.summary: Plan and execute the create brand reverse-ETL action

commands.risk: external mutation; creates a new BigMailer brand (sending identity); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.risk: external mutation; creates a contact in a BigMailer brand; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create field reverse-ETL action

commands.risk: external mutation; creates a custom contact field in a BigMailer brand; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create list reverse-ETL action

commands.risk: external mutation; creates a contact list in a BigMailer brand; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create message type reverse-ETL action

commands.risk: external mutation; creates a message type (unsubscribe category) in a BigMailer brand; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create segment reverse-ETL action
